# `concat`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the concatenation of col1, col2, ..., colN.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
concat(col1, col2, ..., colN)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `collection_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments |  |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- concat, example 1
> SELECT concat('Spark', 'SQL');
SparkSQL
```

```sql
-- concat, example 2
> SELECT concat(array(1, 2, 3), array(4, 5), array(6));
[1,2,3,4,5,6]
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
